_comment: US market-moving events. PROVISIONAL: dates follow the standard release calendar (jobs report = first Friday 08:30 ET, CPI = mid-month 08:30 ET, FOMC decision = Wednesday 14:00 ET, PCE = late month). Verify each date against federalreserve.gov and bls.gov when maintaining this file — the build renders only future events and warns when the list runs low.

events.name: Jackson Hole Economic Symposium
events.note: The Fed chair's keynote has repeatedly reset rate expectations for the rest of the year.

events.name: August jobs report (nonfarm payrolls)
events.note: Payrolls, unemployment and wages in one print — the month's biggest data risk.

events.name: August CPI
events.note: The inflation print the Fed's next move gets judged against.

events.name: FOMC rate decision + projections
events.note: Decision at 2:00, dot plot alongside, press conference at 2:30 — three chances to move markets.

events.name: August PCE inflation
events.note: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge; matters most when it disagrees with CPI.

events.name: September jobs report (nonfarm payrolls)
events.note: First payrolls print of Q4 — sets the tone for year-end rate pricing.

events.name: September CPI
events.note: Last CPI before the November FOMC meeting.

events.name: Q3 GDP, advance estimate
events.note: First read on third-quarter growth; big revisions are common, big surprises move rates.

events.name: FOMC rate decision
events.note: No projections at this one — the statement language and presser carry all the signal.

events.name: October jobs report (nonfarm payrolls)
events.note: Two days after the FOMC — a strong or weak print immediately re-tests the decision.

events.name: October CPI
events.note: Shapes whether December brings a move or a hold.

events.name: November jobs report (nonfarm payrolls)
events.note: The last payrolls print the December FOMC sees.

events.name: FOMC rate decision + projections
events.note: Year-end decision with a fresh dot plot — the market's map for next year.

events.name: November CPI
events.note: Lands the morning after the Fed — confirmation or contradiction, either moves markets.
